source_open_items.topic: Existing recessed pooja niche: estimated dimensions and depth hold (HD-16)
source_open_items.issue: Homeowner estimates: width about 2 ft, sill about 1 ft 5 in, top about 7 ft, depth about 1 ft 3 in and north-corner-to-edge gap about 1 ft 4 in. These are not site measurements. The reported extension beyond the modeled wall is not dimensioned and the balcony-edge pair is unresolved. Measure niche, extension and light feeds; obtain professional review of support and permissible loads. No cutting or deepening is requested. One fixed platform is intended roughly halfway up the niche; exact elevation and idol/picture sizes and positions remain unmeasured. The homeowner selected small idols with a framed picture behind for display only; site fit, thermal/fire clearance and support/capacity require verification.

Measure on one finished flat: finished floor to slab underside, slab thickness, floor-finish build-up, perimeter band underside, raised centre-panel level and any step, the hall cross-beam depth and soffit, and the kitchen, bathroom, utility and lobby ceiling levels. The drawings use 11 ft floor-to-floor, a 5 in slab and 1.5 in finish (so 3.188 m to the soffit) and a 9 in band drop (2.959 m). These are homeowner-stated or derived figures, not site measurements.
